definitions.gloss: full amount; total sum; entire amount
definitions.explanation: The complete monetary amount without any deduction or reduction.

examples.japanese: {全額|ぜんがく}⟦{返金|へんきん}します→返金する：21322_henkinsuru⟧。
examples.english: We will refund the full amount.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅費|りょひ}→旅費：20646_ryohi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{全額|ぜんがく}{負担|ふたん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The company will cover the full travel expenses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{奨学金|しょうがくきん}→奨学金：03230_shougakukin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{学費|がくひ}→学費：04706_gakuhi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{全額|ぜんがく}⟦{免除|めんじょ}→免除：05764_menjo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらえた→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the scholarship, I had the full tuition waived.

notes:
{全額|ぜんがく} refers to the complete monetary amount with no deductions. It combines ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧ (all) + ⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧ (amount).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全額|ぜんがく}⟦{返金|へんきん}→返金：06130_henkin⟧: full refund
- {全額|ぜんがく}{負担|ふたん}: bearing the full cost
- {全額|ぜんがく}⟦{免除|めんじょ}→免除：05764_menjo⟧: full exemption/waiver
- {全額|ぜんがく}⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧: to pay in full
- {全額|ぜんがく}{返済|へんさい}: full repayment

USAGE:
Common in business, legal, and administrative contexts. Often functions adverbially: {全額|ぜんがく}⟦{返金|へんきん}します→返金する：21322_henkinsuru⟧ (We will refund the full amount).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧: half price
- ⟦{総額|そうがく}→総額：05472_sougaku⟧: total amount, grand total
- ⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧: amount of money (general)
